changelog:
- Critical Stability Fix: Eliminated background thread WebView checkThread() violation in shouldInterceptRequest that caused the app to close when tapping buttons or navigating.
- New Home Screen Action Buttons: Dual Screen split-deck multitasking and Fokk Shield defense buttons with pure black-and-white minimalist vector icons.
- Curated Sail & Horizon 4K Wallpapers: Added prominent Sailboat & Ocean collection with local 4K photography.
- Zero-Glitch Visual Discovery Grid: Stable 2-column grid with smooth image fallbacks and zero layout shift.
- X.com (Twitter) Complete Loading Fix: Exempted Twitter from script tampering and synthetic request blocks.
